entwurf.thema: Backchannel: one thread for every page's comments

teile.name: The two-tab problem
teile.text: Why open two tabs for every article? Backchannel puts the community's comments beside the page, so you can read both.
teile.szene: Painted open-world-game poster style: a black-haired man in a black leather jacket and glowing cyan glasses sits at a cafe table, frowning at a laptop seen from behind, medium shot, neon dusk light.

teile.name: One blended thread
teile.text: Say you're reading an article from Hacker News. It blends Hacker News, Bluesky, Reddit and more into one thread.
teile.szene: Genuine Backchannel project page and demo material showing the merged discussion thread beside an article, close view of the sidebar with comments from several sources.

teile.name: The BC button
teile.text: Browse as usual. If a discussion exists for that page, the BC button lights up, so you know people are talking.
teile.szene: Painted open-world-game poster style: the cyan-glasses presenter in a leather jacket leans toward a glowing laptop on a rooftop at night, over-the-shoulder medium shot, warm city lights.

teile.name: Not just reading
teile.text: So is it read-only? No. Vote, reply and even submit on supported sources, using the session you already have there.
teile.szene: Painted open-world-game poster style: the presenter in black leather jacket and cyan glasses types a reply with a satisfied half-smile in a dim apartment, close-up on face and hands, soft cyan glow.

teile.name: Annotations
teile.text: Turn on annotations, and quotes in comments get matched back to the article. Click one to filter the thread.
teile.szene: Genuine Backchannel project documentation showing highlighted passages in an article and the filtered discussion thread beside it, tight crop on the highlight.

teile.name: The catch
teile.text: The catch: Reddit gets the pages you visit. With Bluesky switched on, pages go to Constellation, an independent index.
teile.szene: Painted open-world-game poster style: the presenter in leather jacket and cyan glasses studies a long list on a glowing laptop with a thoughtful, cautious look, medium shot, moody blue street light.

teile.name: Closing
teile.text: One tab, one thread. Be sure to like, share and save this video.
teile.szene: Painted open-world-game poster style: the presenter in black leather jacket and cyan glasses reads one calm browser window with a content smile at a cafe table, medium shot, warm evening light.

entwurf.beschreibung: Backchannel blends Hacker News, Bluesky, Reddit and more into one discussion thread beside the page you read. The video also covers which hosts receive the pages you visit.
